name: C Programming
description: C syntax, control flow, functions, recursion, memory allocation, arrays, strings, and pointer arithmetic.

name: Programming & Data Structures
description: Arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, binary trees, BSTs, heaps, and graph representations.

name: Algorithms
description: Asymptotic analysis, recurrences, greedy, dynamic programming, divide & conquer, and graph algorithms.

name: Discrete Mathematics
description: Propositional & first-order logic, sets, relations, functions, partial orders, lattices, combinatorics, and graph theory.

name: Digital Logic
description: Boolean algebra, K-maps, combinational circuits (multiplexers, decoders), and sequential circuits (flip-flops, counters).

name: Computer Organization & Architecture
description: Machine instructions, addressing modes, ALU, data-path, control unit, memory hierarchy, cache mapping, I/O, and pipelining.

name: Databases (DBMS)
description: ER-model, relational model, relational algebra, SQL, integrity constraints, normal forms, B/B+ trees, transactions & concurrency.

name: Operating Systems
description: Processes, threads, CPU scheduling, synchronization, semaphores, deadlocks, virtual memory, paging, and file systems.

name: Computer Networks
description: OSI & TCP/IP layers, framing, error control, CSMA/CD, routing, IPv4, CIDR, UDP, TCP flow & congestion control, DNS, HTTP.

name: Theory of Computation
description: Regular expressions, DFAs, NFAs, pumping lemma for regular languages, CFGs, PDAs, Turing machines, and undecidability.

name: Compiler Design
description: Lexical analysis, top-down and bottom-up parsing (LL, LR, LALR), syntax-directed translation, intermediate code, and optimizations.

name: Engineering Mathematics
description: Linear algebra (matrices, determinants, eigenvalues), calculus (limits, maxima/minima), probability and statistics.

name: General Aptitude
description: Verbal aptitude (English grammar, vocabulary) and quantitative aptitude (data interpretation, numerical computation, reasoning).
